title: Logspace uniformity of the tableau family
statement: For every finite-state Turing machine $M$ with Boolean input and output alphabets and all natural numbers $C,d$, the circuit family whose $n$th circuit is the configuration-tableau circuit for $M$ with time bound $(C+1)(n+1)^d$ is logspace-uniform.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ over Boolean symbols
